Listings.Description:
FanFolder puts your latest files one click away on the Windows taskbar. Stop digging through File Explorer for files you just used — click the FanFolder icon to open an animated fan of files, then open, drag, copy, rename, or delete them using familiar Windows shell actions.

Use it for recent documents, an active project folder, Downloads, Desktop, Documents, or any folder you open often.

FanFolder is a small native Win32/C++ application with no .NET runtime dependency. The executable is about 161 KB. All settings are stored in the Windows registry and are accessible via the tray icon menu.
Listings.WhatsNew: Explorer's Recent files list (::RecentFiles::) is now exposed in the tray Folder submenu, alongside ::RecentDocs:: and ::GraphRecent::.
ProductFeatures: Animated arc/fan popup anchored to the taskbar
Multiple animation styles: Fan, Glide, Spring, Fade, None
Adaptive icon size with shell icons and file thumbnails
Configurable folder, sort order, item count, and filename filter
Sort by date modified, date created, or name
Shell context menu (open, copy, delete, rename) on right-click
Drag-and-drop items out of the menu to other applications
Drop files from Explorer onto the fan menu to move them into the watched folder
All settings stored in the Windows registry — accessible via the tray icon menu
Listings.ShortDescription: Your latest files, one click away from the Windows taskbar. Open an animated fan of files from any folder.

Properties.CertificationNotes: FanFolder is a per-user Win32 taskbar utility. The MSI installer installs to %LOCALAPPDATA% (no admin elevation required). Silent install: msiexec /i FanFolderSetup-x64.msi /quiet /norestart. The app launches on login via HKCU Run key. No system services, no drivers, no kernel components. Telemetry: a single anonymous app_installed event is sent once per installation via Aptabase (EU-hosted, privacy-friendly). No personal data, file paths, or usage details are collected. Opt out via TelemetryEnabled=0 in HKCU\SOFTWARE\FanFolder. Privacy notice: https://olebhartvigsen.github.io/FanFolder/privacy
